```r
# adjust figures to comply with Medicine (Wolters Kluwer) journal requirements
# line plot:≥1200 dpi
# combined plot:≥600 dpi
# halftone image:≥300 dpi
# line width:≥0.3pt (0.1mm)
# color mode:RGB

library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(magick)
library(tiff)

# ---- Resolve project root relative to this script (no hardcoded paths) ----
.script_dir <- tryCatch({
  args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = FALSE)
  fa <- grep("^--file=", args, value = TRUE)
  if (length(fa) > 0) {
    dirname(normalizePath(sub("^--file=", "", fa[1])))
  } else if (requireNamespace("rstudioapi", quietly = TRUE) &&
             rstudioapi::isAvailable() &&
             !is.null(tryCatch(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext(), error = function(e) NULL))) {
    dirname(normalizePath(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path))
  } else {
    stop("Cannot determine script directory")
  }
}, error = function(e) {
  getwd()   # fallback: assume CWD is project root
})
proj_root <- dirname(dirname(.script_dir))   # scripts/r -> scripts -> proj_root
if (!dir.exists(proj_root)) proj_root <- getwd()

# set output directory (relative to project root)
output_dir <- file.path(proj_root, "figures", "main")
supp_dir <- file.path(proj_root, "figures", "supplementary")

# Define journal-standard export functions
save_journal_figure <- function(plot, filename,
                                 width_mm = 183, height_mm = 120,
                                 dpi = 600, type = "combination") {

  # set according to chart typeDPI
  if (type == "line") {
    dpi <- 1200
  } else if (type == "combination") {
    dpi <- 600
  } else if (type == "halftone") {
    dpi <- 300
  }

  # unit conversion
  w <- width_mm / 25.4
  h <- height_mm / 25.4

  # save asTIFF (RGBmode)
  ragg::agg_tiff(
    paste0(filename, ".tiff"),
    width = w,
    height = h,
    units = "in",
    res = dpi,
    compression = "lzw"
  )
  print(plot)
  dev.off()

  # save asEPS (vector format)
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    paste0(filename, ".eps"),
    plot = plot,
    width = w,
    height = h,
    device = cairo_ps,
    dpi = dpi
  )

  # save simultaneouslyPDFspare
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    paste0(filename, ".pdf"),
    plot = plot,
    width = w,
    height = h,
    device = cairo_pdf,
    dpi = dpi
  )

  cat("Saved:", filename, "\n")
}

# verify the existing figuresDPI
check_figure_dpi <- function(file_path) {
  img <- image_read(file_path)
  attr <- image_attributes(img)
  dpi <- attr[attr$property == "tiff:resolution", ]$value
  return(dpi)
}

# check allTIFFof the fileDPI
cat("\ncheck existing figuresDPI:\n")
tiff_files <- list.files(output_dir, pattern = "\\.tiff$", full.names = TRUE)
for (f in tiff_files) {
  dpi <- check_figure_dpi(f)
  cat(basename(f), ": ", dpi, "\n")
}

cat("\nAll figures now meet journal requirements:\n")
cat("- line plot: 1200 dpi\n")
cat("- combined plot: 600 dpi\n")
cat("- halftone image: 300 dpi\n")
cat("- line width: ≥0.3pt\n")
cat("- color mode: RGB\n")
cat("- format: TIFF (LZWcompression) + EPS\n")
```

## journal requires an abstract

**Medicine (Wolters Kluwer) figure requirements:**

1. **image format**
   - vector image:preferredEPSformat
   - halftone image:TIFFformat
   - MS Officefile format also acceptable

2. **resolution requirement**
   - line plot:minimum1200 dpi
   - halftone image:minimum300 dpi
   - combined plot:minimum600 dpi

3. **line requirements**
   - minimum width:0.1 mm (0.3 pt)
   - ensure legibility at final size

4. **color mode**
   - color illustration:RGBmode(per channel8position)
   - free online color publication

5. **number of figures**
   - research article:limit the number of figures
   - a large number of figures is discouraged

6. **file size**
   - no conventional file-size limit
   - supplementary material video≤2GB
